title: The Last House
author: Sable Almeida
blurb: Paloma Dunmore, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
